subject.title: fix(gateway): count pending restarts toward maxRestartsPerHour budget

question: Should `channelMaxRestartsPerHour` remain a strict ceiling on health-monitor `startChannel` calls, or may a pending recovery receive one unrecorded completion call beyond it?
rationale: Both interpretations can prevent infinite loops, but the PR deliberately changes a documented operator-facing limit and only a gateway owner can confirm whether the extra handoff is intended product behavior.

options.title: Approve one completion call
options.body: Retain the one-shot max-plus-one pending handoff, align the configuration documentation, and require real adapter proof before merge.

options.title: Keep a strict ceiling
options.body: Revise the state machine so every `startChannel` call counts while preserving a way for an admitted pending recovery to complete without starvation.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Hold or close the PR if neither the extra-call policy nor a strict-ceiling redesign has owner support.

recommendation.title: Approve one completion call
recommendation.body: Retain the one-shot max-plus-one pending handoff, align the configuration documentation, and require real adapter proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent gateway lifecycle work and ownership of the surrounding configuration documentation make them the best available decision-routing candidate.
